regenerationCommand: python3 scripts/verify_sequence.py && python3 scripts/extract_frames.py && python3 scripts/build_sequence.py all   # run inside assets/pm25-luxury/frame-first-v1/

sourceOfTruth.originalCollages: originals/*.jpeg (sha256 recorded per tier; DO NOT duplicate into this package)
sourceOfTruth.note: locked-scene-v3 is immutable read-only input. Normalized frames here are built ONLY from the committed cells; originals are never copied.

nativeVsDerivedPolicy: frames/frame-NN.webp are NATIVE frames (deterministic geometric normalization of committed cells only: uniform rescale + horizon crop + circular shift). No pixels are invented. preview-xfade250.webp additionally contains DERIVED blended intermediates (PIL Image.blend of adjacent native frames); they are labeled type=blendDerived in approachB_xfade250.compositionExplicit and must never be presented as native.

horizon.rule: row in [0.45H,0.75H] maximizing sum|vertical gradient| (luminance), 8% side margins excluded
horizon.clampRule: crop top clamped to [0, H-120]; recorded per frame

horizontal.rule: circular cross-correlation of column-luminance profile vs frame-01, integer shift -40..+40, applied as circular roll

metrics.note: diffs computed on the final registered/saved WEBP frames (decoded), registration included

approachB_xfade250.note: blend intermediates are DERIVED from adjacent native frames; never native

noOverlayPolicy: This phase produces geometric registration ONLY. No decorative overlay assets (birds/leaves/particles/smoke or any sprite layers) were created; locked-scene-v3 effects atlases are untouched.
